title: success complex fields
name: Success complex fields
rule: For complex fields, show successful entry (and instant rules as the user types) without spamming success on merely-required empty-to-filled fields.

citation.source: NN/g — 10 Design Guidelines for Reporting Errors in Forms (§2)

pass_when: A complex field (multiple rules, e.g. password) shows success and/or live rule checks; simple required fields do not get a success state for merely becoming non-empty.
fail_when: Complex field shows only errors, or every required field flashes success when filled.
overview: Show success and live rules on complex fields; skip success spam on simple fills.
apply_when: Validating passwords or multi-rule fields during typing.
not_when: Simple required fields that only need non-empty checks.
agent_hint: Surface live success on complex rules; never flash success on every fill.
description: Complex fields with several rules (for example a password) should show successful entry and live rule checks as the user types. Simple required fields must not get a success state merely for becoming non-empty — that floods the form with noise. Pass when the complex field shows success and/or live checks while plain required fields stay quiet until a real rule is met; fail when the complex field shows only errors, or every required field flashes success when filled.
